mainEntity.name: Do I need to rebuild the framing if I’m changing a door opening size?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you’re changing the size of an existing doorway or cutting a new opening, the frame usually needs to be rebuilt so the header, king studs, and jack studs support the wall correctly. In Denver, those changes typically also trigger a permit review when the opening size is altered or a new doorway is created.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Changing a doorway size usually means redoing the framing so the opening is properly supported, and Denver generally requires permits for resizing or creating a new doorway.
